'''Cho'pa'ailor''', also known as '''Chopper''', was a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Cho'pa'ailor operated a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] repair shop in [[Quadrant L-42]] of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of Pyke Syndicate, operatives stole some encoded data regarding the identity of a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who had betrayed the Syndicate and they passed the data on to Cho'pa'ailor, who decrypted the information and identified the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] as the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]]. The Besalisk then proceeded to commission the operatives to hunt down Leeachos on behalf of the Syndicate.<ref name="UABS" />
